title: Love your mom
textBlocks:
Hello Bravehearts
In today’s lesson you will hear that God wants you to be kind, loving and caring towards your mom

Do you remember the 10 commandments?
The Lord gave Moses 10 special rules written on stone tablets

Well rule number 5, the one right in the middle is about your MOM and DAD
IT SAYS:
HONOUR YOUR PARENTS
But what does that mean?
Lets watch the video…

Prayer Time
Dear Lord Jesus
Thank you so much for my mom
Please help me to be kind to her
To care for her feelings and to love her
Amen
